Chapter 10: The Ongoing Work—Kinship in a Changing World
As the twentieth century rolled into the twenty-first, Covert found itself standing at the edge of a brand-new era. The world was more connected than ever before, but wow, it was also a lot more complicated. Old prejudices? They hadn’t disappeared—they just showed up in new disguises. Economic changes brought fresh opportunities, sure, but also a fair bit of uncertainty. And the faces around town started to shift, as new families put down roots and others moved on.
Still, the spirit that shaped Covert from the very start? That stayed strong. The school kept its doors wide open for kids from every background. The church carried on, welcoming anyone who wanted to come in. And those beloved community events—like the picnics, the festivals, and volunteer days—they were still the heartbeat of the town, where differences weren’t just accepted, they were celebrated.
Imagine this: a teenager, brand new to Covert, feeling totally out of place, gets asked to join the local soccer team. At first, she hangs back, not sure she belongs. But her teammates remember how tough those first days can be. They make room for her, cheer her on, and even let her in on their inside jokes. By the end of the season? She’s right there with them, feeling like she belongs.
And then there’s an older resident, looking back on all the changes over the years. He’s honest—it hasn’t always been easy. There are still moments of misunderstanding, times when old habits just won’t let go. But he finds comfort in knowing the town’s foundation is strong. “We’ve been through a lot,” he says, “but we always find our way back to each other.”
Most folks don’t see how much work it takes to keep a community together. In Covert, kinship isn’t just something you talk about—it’s a daily practice. It means listening, forgiving, and reaching out, even when it’s uncomfortable. It means holding on to the lessons of the past, but also keeping your heart open to what’s coming next.
As new generations step up, the story of Covert keeps unfolding. The real legacy of this town isn’t just tucked away in its history books—it’s alive and ongoing. It’s a living promise that, with courage and care, people really can build something better, together.
